popularityEstimates.description: 估算值(0-1)，综合参考知乎、Trip.com、小红书、TripAdvisor、上博官方数据等

items.name: 青铜馆
items.notes: 上博最核心展厅，大克鼎等镇馆之宝集中于此；几乎所有攻略首推
items.notesEN: The museum's core gallery; Da Ke Ding and other masterpieces; top of nearly every guide.

items.name: 书法馆
items.notes: 王羲之、王献之、怀素三大国宝级书法；海内外唯一通史书法陈列
items.notesEN: Wang Xizhi, Wang Xianzhi, Huaisu - three national-treasure calligraphies; the world's only comprehensive calligraphy survey.

items.name: 绘画馆
items.notes: 高逸图等国宝级书画；但书画类展品轮换展示，不一定每次都能看到全部
items.notesEN: National-treasure works such as Gaoyi Tu; works rotate, so not all may be on view.

items.name: 雕塑馆
items.notes: 白石供养菩萨像等；1/3首次展出；视觉冲击力强
items.notesEN: White Stone Offering Bodhisattva and more; a third shown publicly for the first time; strong visual impact.

items.name: 特展（如莎士比亚展、三星堆展）
items.notes: 上博特展现象级，'金字塔之巅'曾引发排队数小时；2026年美洲文明大展预期极高
items.notesEN: Shanghai Museum's special exhibitions are phenomenal; 'Pyramid's Top' once drew hours-long queues; the 2026 Americas exhibition is highly anticipated.

items.name: 玉器馆
items.notes: 良渚文化玉器等；对中国玉文化感兴趣的游客评价高
items.notesEN: Liangzhu-culture jades and more; praised by visitors interested in Chinese jade culture.

items.name: 陶瓷馆
items.notes: 体系最完整的陶瓷通史；瓷器爱好者必到
items.notesEN: The most complete ceramic survey; a must for porcelain lovers.

items.name: 屋顶花园
items.notes: 天气好时景色佳；但受天气影响大
items.notesEN: Great views in good weather, but highly weather-dependent.

items.name: 玺印篆刻馆
items.notes: 海内外首个印章专题展；小众但专业
items.notesEN: The world's first dedicated seal exhibition; niche but professional.

items.name: 江南文化馆
items.notes: 空间设计出色；展品相对轻松

items.name: 考古上海馆
items.notes: 上海本地历史；外地游客可能兴趣一般
items.notesEN: Shanghai's local history; may interest out-of-town visitors less.

items.name: CeraMIX馆
items.notes: 全新常设展；中外交流视角独特
items.notesEN: A brand-new permanent gallery; a unique China-and-world exchange perspective.

items.name: 上海书画馆
items.notes: 海派文化专题；本地游客更感兴趣
items.notesEN: A Shanghai-school culture feature; of more interest to local visitors.

popularityEstimates.descriptionEN: Estimated values (0-1), synthesizing Zhihu, Trip.com, Xiaohongshu, TripAdvisor and official Shanghai Museum data.
